title: 第15章 大师出手张家求和第16章 炼气突破凝气成兵
content_zh:
和张家会馆的人一样，一开始根本没人相信玄阳大师会在叶家会馆开炉炼丹。
直到一个卡在气武境九层多年的武者，为求突破，试着到叶家会馆买下了一瓶二品丹药，而后竟然顺利突破到了真武境！
“仅一瓶丹药就打破了我多年的瓶颈，这绝对是二品顶级的丹药啊！”
那个突破的武者兴奋异常。
有了他宣传，他的亲朋好友也都来到了叶家会馆，选购了一批丹药后，果然发现全都是精品丹药。
继而一传十，十传百，越来越多的人蜂拥而来。
开玩笑，玄阳大师炼制的丹药，那都是极为顶级的，即便在强者如云的王都城，那都是金字招牌，受到无数强者的追捧。
对于北荒城的这些低阶武者而言，那更是无上至宝。
顶级丹药的药效最好，副作用也最低，最适合武者突破。
当然价格也是极高的，要比普通的同品级丹药高上数倍不止，平日里只有大罗商盟有得卖，普通武者哪里消费的起？
但叶家会馆的这种顶级丹药，却是面向大众，价格亲民。
这样的好机会，谁肯错过？
北荒城轰动了！
无数人都扛着大包小包的灵石，甚至砸锅卖铁涌向叶家会馆，即便现在用不到，也要多屯一些，甚至转手一卖就能大赚一笔。
一时间，北荒城万人空巷，把叶家会馆的门都挤破了。
长长的队伍，甚至排到了对面街市的张家会馆门前，而且还在极速拉长。
张家会馆的人，此刻全都傻眼了。
刚才他们这里还门庭若市，转瞬之间就已经空无一人，甚至连他们内部的工作人员，都悄悄加入了队伍。
不久，张家高层都被惊动，看着桌案前从叶家会馆买回来的丹药，陷入了沉默。
“药效保存完好，无一丝外泄，的确都是顶级的丹药！”

“这怎么可能？叶家供奉的炼丹师都被我们挖走了，他们哪儿来的顶级丹药？”
“我看他们八成是从大罗商盟高价买来，低价售出，想与我张家血拼一场！”
这是唯一的可能，毕竟玄阳大师何等人物，岂会去叶家会馆？
“如果真是如此，那叶家即便把家族底蕴掏空，也根本撑不了多久，我们就拭目以待吧！”
张家的高层们暂时并不担心。
毕竟这种高价买入，低价卖出的生意，无异于自杀。
然而一整天过去了，叶家会馆依旧火爆无比，即便是在夜间人们也不愿离开。
不断有人兴奋的从叶家会馆跑出来，激动的大吼发财了，或者可以突破了。
到了第二天，北荒城附近各城的人都赶来了，彻底把周边的街市堵死，人潮汹涌，好不壮观。
叶家会馆这边，面对越来越火爆的场面，所有人都累得近乎虚脱，但脸上依旧充斥着激动和振奋的笑容。
仅仅一天时间，他们就完成了往常一个月的盈利。
谁不兴奋？
期间，有不少人都建议叶倾城加价出售。
现在这种情况，顶级丹药深入人心，就算把价格再提升个两三倍，人们依旧会买账，到时就能赚个盆满钵满。
然而叶倾城却果断拒绝了。
暴增的盈利，看着的确让人眼红，但天性冷静聪慧的她很清楚，这些都是玄阳大师带来的。
可她到现在还没搞清楚，玄阳大师主动相助的真正用意。
而且玄阳大师不可能一直留在叶家会馆，若是现在趁机抬价，人们虽然会买账，但心中也肯定会忌恨。
content_en:
Like the people in the Zhang Family Guild Hall, no one believed that Master Xuanyang would start alchemy in the Ye Family Guild Hall at first.
Until a warrior who had been stuck in the ninth level of the Qi Martial Realm for many years, in order to break through, tried to buy a bottle of second-grade elixir at the Ye Family Guild Hall, and then he successfully broke through to the True Martial Realm!
"Just one bottle of elixir has broken my bottleneck that I have had for many years. This is definitely a top-notch second-grade elixir!"
The warrior who broke through was extremely excited.
With his publicity, his relatives and friends also came to the Ye Family Guild Hall, and after purchasing a batch of elixirs, they found that they were all high-quality elixirs.
Then it was spread from one to ten, and from one to another, more and more people came.
Just kidding, the elixirs refined by Master Xuanyang are all top-notch. Even in the capital city where there are many powerful people, they are golden signs and are sought after by countless powerful people.
For these low-level warriors in Beihuang City, it is even more of a supreme treasure.
Top-grade elixirs have the best efficacy and the lowest side effects, making them the most suitable for warriors to achieve breakthroughs.
Of course, the price is also extremely high, several times higher than ordinary elixirs of the same grade. On weekdays, only the Great Luo Merchant Alliance can sell them. How can ordinary warriors afford them?
But this top-quality elixir from the Ye Family Guild Hall is for the general public and the price is close to the people.
Who would miss such a good opportunity?
There was a sensation in Beihuang City!
Countless people are carrying large and small bags of spiritual stones, and even selling them to the Ye Family Guild Hall. Even if they don't need them now, they still want to stock up on more, and they can even make a lot of money by selling them.
For a time, the streets of Beihuang City were empty, and the door of the Ye Family Guild Hall was squeezed open.
The long queue even reached in front of the Zhang Family Guild Hall in the market across the street, and it was still growing rapidly.
Everyone in the Zhang Family Guild Hall was dumbfounded at this moment.
Just now, their place was bustling with people, but in an instant it was deserted. Even their internal staff quietly joined the team.
Soon, the senior officials of the Zhang family were alarmed and fell into silence as they looked at the pills bought from the Ye Family Guild Hall in front of the table.
"The efficacy of the medicine is well preserved and there is no leakage. They are indeed top-notch pills!"
"How is this possible? All the alchemists worshiped by the Ye family have been poached by us. Where did they get the top elixirs?"
"I think they probably bought it from the Daluo Merchant Alliance at a high price and sold it at a low price. They want to have a shopping spree with my Zhang family!"
This is the only possibility. After all, how could Master Xuanyang go to the Ye Family Guild Hall?
"If this is really the case, then even if the Ye family empties out their family heritage, they won't be able to survive for long. Let's just wait and see!"
The senior executives of the Zhang family are not worried for the time being.
After all, this kind of business of buying at high prices and selling at low prices is tantamount to suicide.
However, a whole day has passed, and the Ye Family Guild Hall is still extremely popular, and people are reluctant to leave even at night.
People kept running out of the Ye Family Guild Hall excitedly, shouting excitedly that they had made a fortune or could achieve a breakthrough.
On the second day, people from all the cities near Beihuang City came and completely blocked the surrounding markets. The crowds were so huge that it was so spectacular.
At the Ye Family Guild Hall, facing the increasingly heated scene, everyone was almost exhausted from exhaustion, but their faces were still filled with excited and uplifting smiles.
In just one day, they made a usual month's profit.
Who wouldn't be excited?
During this period, many people suggested that Ye Qingcheng sell at a higher price.
In this current situation, top-quality elixirs are deeply rooted in the hearts of the people. Even if the price is raised two or three times, people will still buy it, and then they can make a lot of money.
However, Ye Qingcheng decisively refused.
The sudden increase in profits is indeed enviable, but she, who is calm and intelligent by nature, knows very well that these are all brought by Master Xuanyang.
But she still hasn't figured out the real intention behind Master Xuanyang's initiative to help.
Moreover, Master Xuanyang cannot stay in the Ye Family Guild Hall forever. If he takes the opportunity to raise the price now, although people will buy it, they will definitely feel jealous in their hearts.
